Job Description
 Ceragon Networks is a global leader in wireless backhaul solutions, providing innovative and reliable connectivity to enterprises and service providers worldwide. Our mission is to enable the world's leading wireless networks to deliver robust, high-performance solutions that ensure seamless and efficient communications across diverse industries.
 About The Department
 The Private Networks Line of Business at Ceragon Networks specializes in integrating best-of-breed partner technologies and solutions to architect and deliver comprehensive, tailor-made connectivity solutions for enterprise and operator customers. Our focus is on identifying optimal technology combinations, validating integration approaches, and demonstrating how diverse ecosystem partners can work together seamlessly. We push the boundaries of what's possible across 4G/5G, IoT/M2M, machine learning, RF/mmWave, network security, virtualization, and emerging wireless technologies—translating innovation into real-world deployments that solve complex customer challenges.
 Position Overview
 ﻿Reports To: Software Support & QA Manager
The Software Quality Assurance Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of OEM‑branded software and internally developed E2E by Ceragon applications. This role validates product functionality through a combination of manual testing, exploratory testing, and automated UI testing using frameworks such as Selenium and Robot Framework.
The position works closely with development, product, and engineering teams to review requirements, design scalable test approaches, identify defects, and support continuous quality improvements.
 Key Responsibilities
 Test Planning & Execution
﻿Review product requirements, design documents, and technical specifications to understand scope and expected behavior.
Develop, maintain, and execute test plans, test cases, and test scripts (manual and automated).
Conduct functional, reliability, performance, and exploratory testing.
Identify and prioritize test cases for automation.
Execute automated regression suites and analyze results.
Validate new features, enhancements, and bug fixes.
 Automation Development
Design, develop, and maintain UI automation scripts using Selenium WebDriver and Robot Framework.
Support the expansion of automation frameworks.
Participate in evaluation of Vaadin TestBench.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
 Defect Identification & Collaboration
Identify, reproduce, document, and track defects.
Verify fixes meet acceptance criteria.
Communicate risks and quality concerns.
 Documentation & Reporting
Prepare QA reports, test summaries, and release readiness documentation.
Maintain test environments and test data.
Contribute to QA standards and process improvements.
 Job Requirements
 What are we looking for
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
3+ years of experience working with software.
1–2+ years of UI automation experience desired.
Desired familiarity with Linux, Windows, scripting, networking concepts, Selenium, Robot Framework, Vaadin TestBench.
Familiarity with Jira is a plus.
Strong documentation skills.
Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
